route: rpc_host command set_host_tools normalizes real definitions.

set_host_tools prepares overlay from current definitions/active names; ToolBridge.adapters returns captured definition adapters and native_owners returns corresponding NativeHostOwner from that exact bridge.
SessionFactory.config publishes a complete candidate Native setup, carrying the exact registered adapter/owner pairs and current grants; root snapshots are refreshed before the Task prompt.
Agent declaration selects the host tool and caller does not set tools, so child_host captures the exact parent RPC adapter/owner and reads parent_native.rpc_grant.
Child Native invocation calls NativeHostOwner.prepare_native -> ToolBridge.prepare_raw. The original pending ID is inserted before synchronous encoding outside locks.
PreparedHostRequest.dispatch checks cancellation/current publication grant and marks that same pending request dispatched before emitting host_tool_call.

Reply through ordinary host_tool_result with the emitted pending id; rpc_host input consumes it through tool_bridge.consume before generic command dispatch. The same pending owner settles the child ToolResult.
cautions: Use host_tool_call.id for the bridge reply, not the model toolCallId. Record both identities.
The later generic command switch lists host_tool_result as unsupported; recognized valid side-channel frames are consumed earlier at7616. Do not infer unreachability from that fallback branch.
Keep nonbuiltin unique registration name and visible active definition. Duplicate/conflicting names are rejected by set_host_tools.
The bridge is the parent connection owner captured by the child. Respond on the parent ordinary RPC input that owns it; do not fabricate a child-only bridge.

critical_route_limit.source: task_host.rs sets restrictToolNames=item.tools.is_some(); child_host.rs536-545 clears owned_mcp and captured_rpc when restricted=true.
critical_route_limit.consequence: A Task with explicit caller tools does not currently carry MCP/RPC adapters into the child, even if preflight sees a true source grant. Declaration-based true transfer and explicit caller negative preflight are different paths.
critical_route_limit.required_reporting: The current Rust restriction matches fixed OMP. Keep positive MCP/RPC grant transfer on agent declarations with no caller tools; explicit caller negative authority cases must reject the full batch. Do not label restricted-source exclusion a bug or expand it into explicit MCP support.

fixed_omp_evidence.content: restrictToolNames=true disables MCP and clears preloaded extension/custom-tool paths.
